newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Iran's oil terminal capacity at 7 mln bpd - NITC.
newsitem.headline: Iran's oil terminal capacity at 7 mln bpd - NITC.

text.p: Iran's oil terminals have a capacity to supply seven million barrels per day (bpd) of oil to world markets, Mohammad Souri, chairman of the state-owned National Iranian Tanker Company (NITC) said on Wednesday.
"Oil terminals in the Islamic republic of Iran alone could easily export up to seven million barrels daily," Souri told delegates at an oil and gas conference in Abu Dhabi.
Iran currently produces 3.7 million bpd of crude and is the world's third largest oil exporter at 2.5 million bpd.
NITC's current fleet stood at 11 Very Large or Ultra Large Crude Carriers and nine product carriers, Souri said.
